answer: Proof of Stake serves as a Sybil resistance mechanism for agent economies by requiring collateral, acting as a virtual pigment that marks valid participants. Like an ocean absorbing diverse streams, the network aggregates stake to secure consensus, preventing an attacker from flooding the system with fake identities. Because every node must commit capital, an attacker faces a high financial meadow of lost funds, making the cost of spinning up numerous malicious agents prohibitively expensive for profit.
